n02.roman: Game wala hissa sirf kalpana hai! Par naap-jokh, Valmiki Ramayan se. Engineer? Vishwakarma ke bete, Nal!

n03.roman: Twist! Track ek din mein nahi bana. Paanch din, paanch stage: 14, 20, 21, 22, 23 yojan!

n04.roman: Kul 100 yojan! Anginat vaanar, ek team bankar, chattaanein aur ped laaye!

n05.roman: Ab asli duniya: Rameswaram ke Pamban dweep se Sri Lanka ke Mannar tak, lagbhag 48 km, uthli chattaanon aur reti ki kadi: Ram Setu ya Adam's Bridge. Wahan paani aam taur par 1-3 metre gehra.

n06.roman: Toh rule? Ye race akele nahi, team se jeeti jaati hai!
